fusions.name: Rigging Cutter
fusions.desc: Fires a pair of linked balls into the first enemy in its path for 26 damage, ignoring armour; the link carries on to 2 more enemies within 4 tiles, each taking 60% of that damage.

fusions.name: Bolas Pair
fusions.desc: Fires 2 linked rounds, each dealing 3 damage with a 20% chance to leave the target [Pinned] for 2 seconds.

fusions.name: Grapple Line
fusions.desc: Fires a line ahead and hauls you 5 tiles forward along it.

fusions.name: Belt-Fed
fusions.desc: Every ability you have comes round 8% sooner.
